Accused Arrested for Alleged Casteist Remarks in Mathura

An individual accused of making allegedly offensive remarks against the Brahmin and Jatav communities has been arrested in Mathura. The accused was apprehended and subsequently sent to jail by the court. The arrest occurred one day after the alleged incident.
